author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner list shows the first page when asked for a page below one
summary: Opening the owner list at page zero or any negative page shows the first page of the normal owner listing instead of the error page.
acceptance_criteria: given more owners than fit on one page, when /owners is requested with page=0, then the response is HTTP 200 and the normal owner listing renders the first page as the current page, matching a request for page=1

given more owners than fit on one page, when /owners is requested with a negative page (page=-1), then the response is HTTP 200 and the normal owner listing renders the first page as the current page, matching a request for page=1
an existing request for page=1 or a page above one behaves as before
non_goals: changing the veterinarian directory's paging, which may share the same fault; the intake names only the owner listing
defining behavior for a page beyond the last page or a non-numeric page value
notes: Owner absent; intake decisions empty. Scope is the quoted request: 'the owner listing treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal listing (HTTP 200)'. No conflict with a recorded requirement or Non-Goals row; REQ-OWN-005 added to docs/prd.md Owner records (narrative clause, anchor, Done-when bullet). Open, left unasked because this slice does not depend on them: (1) whether the vet directory's paging carries the same fault and should be fixed under REQ-VET-001; (2) behavior for a page past the last one or a non-numeric page. Neither is recorded as a non-goal; both stay open for the owner. Autofix audit: no prd-autofix records in the log.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Covered by architecture-principles.md § pattern catalog, Web controller row: normalizing a request parameter to its permitted range is binding, not a business rule, so the clamp belongs in OwnerController and opens no new deviation (the Open Questions item 2 controller-rule deviation does not apply). Cause, read by grep (IDE oracle not connected, weaker basis): OwnerController.findPaginatedForOwnersLastName builds PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize), which rejects a negative page index, so page<=0 throws and the error page renders. Fix shape: normalize page to at least 1 once, at the top of processFindForm, before both the repository lookup and addPaginationModel, so the model's currentPage reads 1 exactly as for page=1. The only docs/ write is REQ-OWN-005 joining the OwnerController Contracts row in docs/system-design.md § Contracts.
integration_points: Entry point binding: GET /owners keeps its existing binding, a primitive page request parameter plus the Owner search probe, and no new bound field is added; the slice adds no new entry point (security-principles.md trust boundary at request binding unchanged).

Boundary OwnerRepository (repository): double is the existing @MockitoBean OwnerRepository fixture in OwnerControllerTests, a framework stub kept as the conscious exception per testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy, because OwnerRepository extends a Spring Data JPA interface whose inherited surface makes a hand-written double disproportionate, and a real implementation would turn this @WebMvcTest into a persistence test. New tests stub findByLastNameStartingWith with a multi-owner page and assert the Pageable passed has page number 0.
Boundary HTTP transport: MockMvc, the sanctioned framework harness (CLAUDE.md Testing Strategy); assert status 200, view owners/ownersList, and model attribute currentPage equal to 1.

risks.risk: Clamping only the repository call leaves addPaginationModel reporting currentPage 0 or negative, so the listing would not match a page=1 request (acceptance criteria 1 and 2).
risks.mitigation: Normalize the page variable once before both uses; tests assert model currentPage is 1 (architecture-principles.md, Web controller row).

risks.risk: Owner listing path scales with owner count; docs/system-design.md carries no Scale and Load section, so no row exists to cite.
risks.mitigation: The slice adds no data-scaling path: the clamp is constant-time and the existing fixed-size page query is unchanged; simplest readable form. Size unrecorded, treated as bounded.

notes: Autofix audit: no design-doc-autofix records in the log. Non-goals respected: VetController paging (which may share the same PageRequest fault) and pages past the last or non-numeric values stay out of scope per the prd-entry. Brief gap for the owner, not blocking: docs/system-design.md has no Scale and Load section.

findings.description: Both new tests are named after the production method (processFindForm...), the implementation-name form docs/testing-principles.md § Test Naming rejects. The brief binds tests written after 2026-07-31 to `the{Subject}Should{Outcome}`; a name that survives renaming processFindForm is not a behavior name. Host-file convention applies only where the brief is silent. The names are also declared in the prd-entry test_names, so the rename must be mirrored there (coverage-map matches declared names).
findings.fix: Rename to behavior names, e.g. theOwnerListShouldShowTheFirstPageWhenPageIsZero and theOwnerListShouldShowTheFirstPageWhenPageIsNegative (or the merged name below), and keep the declared test_names in step.

findings.description: Each test ends with verify(this.owners).findByLastNameStartingWith(eq(""), argThat(pageable -> pageable.getPageNumber() == 0)). It restates an outcome the behavioral assertions already cover: the controller builds PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize) before the repository call (design-block risk text, OwnerController.findPaginatedForOwnersLastName), which throws on a negative index, so an unclamped page cannot yield status 200 plus currentPage 1. Brief § Mocking Policy: an interaction assertion restating an outcome a behavioral assertion covers is noise. Checked with grep -n -e 'verify(' -e 'should(' on the changed test file: only these two hits are new. Behavioral assertions not duplicated by it: status().isOk() and model().attribute("currentPage", 1).
findings.fix: Drop both verify(...argThat(...)) lines and the now unused verify/argThat/eq imports if nothing else uses them.

findings.description: page=0 and page=-1 go through one decision path (a single Math.max(page, 1) in processFindForm) and yield the same kind of outcome (200, ownersList, currentPage 1). Brief § Coverage: a second test through the same equivalence class proves nothing further, and same-outcome rows belong in one table. The two tests differ only in the URL and duplicate five assertion lines. Change either input and both fail together.
findings.fix: Merge into one @ParameterizedTest with @ValueSource(strings = {"0", "-1"}), with a name stating both rows (e.g. theOwnerListShouldShowTheFirstPageWhenPageIsBelowOne). Update the prd-entry test_names to match. Keep page=1 covered by the existing processFindFormSuccess.
